name: io.github.ishaanpilar/stride
title: Stride
description: Task automation via SQLite, desktop Local API, or Stride Cloud; read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: STRIDE_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the local Stride SQLite database.

environmentVariables.name: STRIDE_MCP_CLOUD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional self-hosted Stride Cloud base URL for Cloud mode.

environmentVariables.name: STRIDE_MCP_CLOUD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for self-hosted Stride Cloud mode.

environmentVariables.name: STRIDE_MCP_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Desktop Local API origin, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3456. Selects API mode.

environmentVariables.name: STRIDE_MCP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token from the desktop Local API settings; required in API mode.
